name: Allina Health hospital and clinic volunteers (ages 15 and up)
what_you_do: Help at an Allina hospital or clinic. Most new helpers at Abbott Northwestern start by showing patients and guests where to go. Other roles help in patient care units, rehab therapy, the gift shop or the front desk.
who_can_apply: Ages 15 and up for hospitals and clinics, and for adaptive sports and recreation. Hospice roles are for ages 18 and up. A background check is only for ages 18 and up.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Abbott Northwestern lists an $8 meal credit each time you volunteer, a free flu shot and free parking.
duration: Abbott Northwestern shifts are on weekdays, 8 a.m. to noon or noon to 4 p.m.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Most people finish the steps in under 30 days.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. Then you have an interview (in person, by phone or by email), take an online class and get a health check for your role. Last, you train in person.
notes: Pick a hospital or clinic when you apply. Each site has its own roles. You need a flu shot each year, or you can ask to skip it. Abbott Northwestern contact: charlie.srock@allina.com. Other questions: volunteer@allina.com.
